rationale: Price continues to print lower highs and lower closes beneath both VWAP and the 9-EMA while relative volume stays elevated at 3.59× and the broader market sells off with VIX futures up more than 5%. The mechanical failure-to-hold-upside structure that justified the original short remains intact even though the tape has reached 2.2% of the daily range. With 133 minutes left and the invalidation still well above the EMA cluster there is no compelling reason to exit or reverse.
